independent_checks: Real gio moves into isolated disposable XDG_DATA_HOME Trash; existing user Trash untouched
Cross-directory collection and duplicate basenames preserve original-path restoration metadata
Cancellation, wrong confirmation, review removal and parent-child normalization
Original inode retained across rescans; replaced entries and symlink ancestors refused
Partial batch failure retains failed entry for later successful retry
Cancellation between actual gio moves retains unprocessed entries for retry
Symlink targets and non-UTF8 filenames preserved correctly
Missing gio never falls back to permanent deletion
Collection survives permanent deletion of another item
Headless real terminal review and confirmation; minimum 60x20 layout inspected
limitations: Collection is in-session, not persisted after exit.
Trashing retains allocation until Trash is emptied.
Preflight validation and external gio path resolution are separate; not atomic against concurrent filesystem swaps. Current mount protection is refreshed before each batch.
Original visual competition and gdu results apply only to baseline176da86; collector release has not been visually rejudged or benchmarked.
host_integration_corrections: Refresh mount guards immediately before each batch
Reject symlink components above the scan root
Rescan after every confirmed batch, including all-refused outcomes
Keep totals and action hints visible in narrow terminals
Describe failed outcomes as retained collection records, without claiming an intact source
